scope: Unvalidated future offering scenarios; no demonstrated technical or commercial superiority
requirements: Same finite permission-fact packet, declared four outcomes, price family and obligations
demand: Same hypothetical values and participation; no observed willingness to pay or buyer acceptance
coordination: No saving credited without evidence; an ordinary shared arrangement is equally capable

human_reference.basis: justified scenario estimates, not published service quotes
human_reference.scope: Interpret source/permission facts, implement finite composition, adversarial checks and package; infrastructure charges additional and never pass-through revenue

cost_boundary.automatic: Native model/tools/execution/checking/correction/packaging forecast; no extra manual-review fee
cost_boundary.human: Replace those automation components with the explicit human estimate; never add both
cost_boundary.all: Retain residual coordination, support, attributable business overhead, failed attempts, defaults and refunds
cost_boundary.B: Primary source scenario retains its single USD5 extra screen; the no-screen counterfactual omits this optional work, never refunds already-incurred work or rebills A
cost_boundary.C: Not commissioned or charged here; optional source research estimates remain separate
cost_boundary.cash: Calculator retains USD10000 initial cash, USD500 reserves and time-ordered prefunding; neither is profit

pricing: Four value-based price hypotheses with declining assumed participation; a finite optimum is not demand
retained_alpha: No measured reusable saving; ordinary identical-content construction ties
